verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented feature for exporting all of a user's Airbyte data (connections, configurations, workspace state) in open formats to leave the platform. The Terraform provider (config-as-code), the public API, log downloads and the open-source self-hosted edition are related capabilities, but none is documented as a full data-export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
